**What would you like added**
e.g. "a Ruby example for /transcript", "a table comparing rate limits per plan".

**Why**
What are you trying to do that the current docs/examples don't cover?

Note: this repo only covers docs and examples for the existing REST API. Feature requests for the API itself (new endpoints, new parameters) belong at https://getyoutubetranscript.com/contact, not here.
